failure.auth: something is wrong with the sign-in or the key
failure.input_too_large: the context is too long to fit

answer.lines: {field}: must be a string or an array of strings
answer.noBlock: No answer found: it goes in a json code block
answer.noEvidence: the conclusion rests on nothing: give at least one piece of evidence

noRoom.runtime: {on} helpers are already at work on {runtime}, at most {max} at once (the Runtimes page can change it)
noRoom.project: {on} helpers are already at work in {project}, at most {max} at once: more would edit the same files

notTaken.conflictOwner: Not merged: merging into {base} would conflict ({files}). {name} is still here, with its branch and worktree. To have it resolve this, tell it: {brief}
notTaken.conflictNotice: {name}'s branch would conflict with {base} ({files}), so it was not merged. It can resolve the conflict itself
notTaken.checkFix:
{reason}
Fix the check and hand it back.

log.stopped: VibeValley stopped, and this round was cut short
log.staleRun: The last round stopped halfway too long ago, and was not carried on
log.quiet: Quiet for {span}{last}. It may be running a long command, or it may be stuck
log.restarted: VibeValley restarted, and this round stopped halfway

usage.cached: cache hit {percent}%: read from cache {read}, missed {missed}, output {output}
usage.unread: how much was read was not reported: output {output}

host.callerStart: I cannot start on my side: {why}
host.markNeedsWords: Write a line on what it should be
host.stepHint: The step numbers are in its log on the page, before each step
host.notAsked: Step {on} is not something {label} was told
host.notInConversation: What step {on} told {label} did not reach its conversation (was {label} not up then?)

life.quietNotice: {name} has been quiet for {span}{last}: open its plot to see what it is doing, and stop it if it is wrong
life.notStopped: The machine did not stop, and its workspace is kept: {why}
life.notReturned: The machine has not handed the workspace back from last time
life.agentGone: {name}'s profile was deleted; it cannot be woken
life.stillClosing: {name}'s machine did not stop: its workspace is kept, and no new round can start
life.noRoom: {name} does not carry on for now: {full}
life.inGraph: {name} is working on a step of the plan {graph}: it merges into the plan's branch when done, and into main with the whole plan
life.stillWorking: {name} is still working: wait for this round to finish, or stop it first, then collect it
life.noRecord: there is no record of it
life.restartedNotice: VibeValley restarted and {name}'s round stopped; tell it something to carry on
life.issueNotReturned: This ticket's machine has not handed the workspace back
life.steered: {name} is at work; the words were put in
life.queued: {name} reads this once this round is done
life.started: {woke, select, true {{name} woke up and starts a new round} other {{name} starts a new round}}
life.notReset: {name}'s working folder could not be reset: {why}
life.stillHasHelper: This ticket still has a helper; its working folder cannot be cleared

conflictBrief: Merging {base} into your branch conflicts ({files}). On your branch, run git merge {base}, resolve the conflicts, run the tests, and commit. In your conclusion, say how each conflict was settled.
